company.description: Iterable is the AI-powered communication platform that organizations trust to build deeper customer relationships through personalized, real-time engagement. With Iterable, leading brands like Priceline, Fabletics, Blockchain, and Box deliver seamless cross-channel experiences by turning data into action and continuously optimizing for maximum impact. Because the future of marketing isn’t about sending more campaigns—it’s about creating moments that matter. Learn more at www.iterable.com.

aiResearchSummary.text: Iterable is researching machine learning techniques for predicting actions and behavior, where a training engine and explanatory engine help specify predictive goals and generate explanatory data for model outputs. It is also developing techniques for segmenting users based on behaviors across electronic channels, transmitting messages subject to multiple rate limits, and scaling workflow campaigns. Together these efforts target behavioral prediction, user segmentation, message delivery control, and campaign orchestration.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series E round raised $200,000,000, or 58.45% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $20,268,331 to $2,000,000,000, a 98.68x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
